name: Alter Weight, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 5, magus 5, sorcerer/ wizard 5, vanguard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a bronze weight used for a measuring scale)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets up to 1 object/level whose total volume is up to 5 cu. ft./level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as alter weight, except as noted above. All targeted objects must be altered in the same way.
